headline: Andrew Tate's extradition fight tests his influence with Trump's America
context: After President Trump took office, Andrew Tate proclaimed, "The Tates will be free." A year later, Tate is being held in federal prison after he was arrested following a U.K. extradition request.

sources.name: NPR
